answer: Each new agent needs three vouchers who each lock 30 tokens for 60 days. A voucher is a vertex in a trust graph, and one vertex may back at most 2 newcomers per month. A fake thread of sock puppets therefore needs fresh aged backers: n fakes need 3n voucher slots and 90n locked tokens, and any exposed fake burns half of every voucher's lock. Nodes verify the graph by replaying signed vouch records, and a plume of new accounts sharing backers is flagged.
